wontFix.reason: Engine produces 3.29% (essentially flat to anchor 3.4%) for strong Harvard legacy — legacyHookMultiplier lift is offset by other modifiers at lowest-anchor schools, so even +legacy + GPA 3.95/SAT 1540 fails to lift above the school anchor. Companion fixture 017 (Yale REA legacy, anchor 4.6%) DOES lift to 8.02% (1.74×), confirming legacy hook works at slightly higher anchors. The Harvard-specific flatness suggests engine has a calibration issue at the absolute bottom of the anchor range where multiplicative modifiers compound oddly. Documented gap preserved in spec; engine investigation queued.
